turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi David, Sarah here. Let us talk about your sales follow-up.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Our forty reps lose hours to unanswered calls and manual CRM updates.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: We can separate unanswered calls from conversations and capture outcomes in your CRM. Which matters more: getting through or keeping follow-up organised?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Both. But I do not want to replace every tool we use.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Then the demo should start with your current workflow. We will show where automation fits and which integrations need checking, rather than promise a complete replacement.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That is helpful. Could we review the details tomorrow afternoon?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Certainly, David. In this demo, we would capture those notes and request a suitable appointment.
